about_short_description.short_description: OneRare is a food metaverse, gaming and NFTs platform.

product.name: Dish NFTs
product.description: Digital collectibles representing dishes that serve as a passport to play games within the OneRare ecosystem.

product.name: Gaming Universe
product.description: A collection of games including Food Truck Wars, Food Fury, and Hippoful, where players use Dish NFTs.

product.name: Market
product.description: A platform for buying cooked dishes directly from chefs, with options to filter by country, ingredients, spice, skill, and time.

product.name: Super Cook
product.description: A feature that evaluates a player's ingredients to cook the maximum number of dishes in one go without any cost.

product.name: Dish Calculator
product.description: A tool that calculates which dishes a player is closest to completing and the cost to cook them up.

product.name: Food Fury Alpha Rush
product.description: A game where players deliver food to earn rewards and climb up the leaderboard for exclusive airdrops.
